correctness.rationale: For the explicit 32-vertex categorical graph product, complete face enumeration (196227 faces including empty) agrees with independent cyclic-column transfer counts. The 98087-pair matching leaves one critical vertex, 24 critical four-cells and 27 critical five-cells; all 1457216 nonempty-face cover relations are oriented and the 196226-vertex Hasse digraph is topologically sorted, certifying no gradient cycles. Oriented integral gradient recursion produces a 24-by-27 matrix with rank 21, unit Smith factors and an explicit 21-by-21 minor of determinant minus one. Hurewicz identifies the attaching maps, proving a wedge of three four-spheres and six five-spheres, not only its Betti numbers. No infinite extrapolation is made.

value.rationale: A 2023/2024 study identifies torsion-freeness for cycle-times-complete-graph independence complexes as an open question and includes the eight-cycle/three-color case; the natural next four-color eight-cycle case was not determined there. The selected eight-cycle is the first even cycle beyond the completely solved four-cycle with length congruent to two modulo three. The result supplies exact integral and homotopy information (3 four-spheres and 6 five-spheres) in two degrees, rather than merely a small face-count or a reparameterized special case. It offers an exact test case for a family where Moore summands are not excluded by prior general theory.
